good_thing: Luján, Argentina: On August 14, 30 lions and tigers began leaving the shuttered former Luján Zoo after years in cramped cages. Four Paws is sending 15 to its Lionsrock sanctuary in South Africa and 15 to The Wild Animal Sanctuary in Colorado, where they will have far larger, more natural habitats.
current_or_history: On this day in 1839, Louis Daguerre’s photographic process was explained step by step at a joint meeting of France’s academies of science and fine arts. Spectators overflowed into the courtyard, eager to learn how an image could be fixed in light.
tiny_fact: Sea otters have loose folds of skin beneath each forearm that work as pockets. They carry gathered food there and may stash favorite rocks for cracking open clams and other mollusks.
